The '''IPG-X1131 ''LongTail''''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] engine designed by the [[Irdani Performance Group/Legends|Irdani Performance Group]]. Such engines were used in [[Teemto Pagalies' Podracer/Legends|Teemto Pagalies' podracer]].

==Characteristics==
At over ten meters in length, the IPG-X1131 ''LongTail'' sported excellent traction and acceleration, able to achieve a maximum speed of 775 kilometers per hour.

Its power was roughly equal to the total power of the [[StarSpeeder 1000]]'s sublight thrusters, since stacking a Podracer equipped with a ''LongTail'' gave a Starspeeder 1000 twice the power after inadvertently snagging the ''LongTail'' during the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] of [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], according to [[C-3PO]].
